related_work.title: Cross-dataset transportability of pediatric chest X-ray deep learning across three countries: discrimination, calibration, operating-point failure, and limited-label recovery
related_work.status: arXiv preprint; peer-review status not independently verified
related_work.relevance: Prior work already studies calibration and fixed-threshold transfer from Guangzhou to BDCXR and VinDr. Our conventional three-architecture comparison is an exploratory benchmark, not a first demonstration of domain shift.
related_work.methodological_difference: Their grouping namespaces bacterial and viral IDs separately; ours conservatively groups all person-number filenames together. Thus identical-looking IDs may over-group different children and remove more development images. Keep the already-frozen cohort and explicitly report this limitation.
related_work.comparison_limit: Different development cohorts, preprocessing and model selection prevent a controlled numerical superiority claim.
